parser.name: marked
parser.operation: marked.lexer only; no HTML render, no inline execution, no PoC/scripts/network

normalization_method: Markdown is lexed recursively through token.tokens. HTML token contents are inspected only with inert attribute regex for href/src/srcset. Ignore schemes, protocol-relative, fragment-only; drop query/fragment; URL-decode path; resolve relative targets against source article directory; normalize POSIX path. Exact normalized target is compared with each missing repository path.
copy_method: Compute Git blob SHA-1 for every public file; compare exact blob ID against missing source assets, then classify same-blob public paths with at most one `.resource` path component and no other dot-prefixed component as normal-level copies.
